name: 书剑恩仇录
group_note: Century/adm-single lineage (adm/single/master.lpc + adm/daemons/securityd.lpc), ShuJian/书剑 codebase. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60 master.lpc log_error() -> CHANNEL_D->do_channel() mid-compile crash, guarded with find_object(CHANNEL_D); same pattern also present in standard_trace() (the runtime error_handler path, not just compile warnings), guarded identically. (2) §7.59 securityd.lpc's valid_read() unconditionally overwrote the driver-supplied 'user' argument with this_player(), denying load_object/include-triggered reads (e.g. BAN_D->is_banned() failing with 'Read access denied' on every single connection, since the very first thing logind.lpc does is check the connecting IP against the ban list before any player has even set an id) -- excluded func=="load_object"/"include" from the override, matching the documented fix. (3) §8.1 unhalved GBK byte-range is_chinese() plus the matching unhalved length-bound check_legal_name() (was 4/8 with an i%2 byte-window, should be 2/4 per-codepoint). (4) §7.50 accept_kill-class is_killing(who) object/string mismatch, but NOT in accept_kill() this time -- in 5 separate NPC reveal-then-kill dialogue files (d/city/npc/{guidao,guidao1,guidao2,xiaosong}.lpc, d/foshan/npc/wanglaohan.lpc, d/shaolin/npc/xiaosong.lpc) that were breaking preload's NPC-spawning compile silently; the same bug is ALSO present in ~20 kungfu/skill/*.lpc files as target->is_killing(me)/ob->is_killing(me) arrow-calls, which don't hard-fail compilation (only the direct/bare calls in the NPC files do) and were left as-is per the standing content-bug-not-exhaustively-fixed convention -- only the blocking instances were fixed. Also seeded admin: fluffos (admin) in the (previously near-empty) adm/etc/wizlist, PLUS an entry in adm/daemons/sited.lpc's hardcoded valid_login mapping (127./0. prefixes) -- this lineage independently enforces a per-wizard-id IP allowlist at login time (sited.lpc's is_valid()), so a freshly wizlist-seeded admin id is otherwise permanently unable to log in from ANY address ('巫师必须有地址限制') until this second table is also seeded -- same 'seed the rank AND the actual permission data' class as AGENTS.md §1.5's trusted-write bug class, just a different table. Verified: full registration (id->confirm->password->confirm->Chinese name->gift roll->confirm->email->gender) -> enter world, permission display shows (admin) correctly. update command's success message could not be captured in the scripted test due to a persistent VIP/welcome-message flood desyncing send timing (not a functional bug -- ADM_PATH and securityd's exclude_read tables were directly source-verified to not exclude (admin) from cmds/app or cmds/imm, where update.lpc lives). One non-blocking content bug logged, not fixed: /d/wudang/npc/th.lpc's create() calls carry_object() with an argument that evaluates to 0 (missing item file), causing a caught 'Bad argument 1 to EFUN call_other()' during baoshid.lpc's preload NPC-placement pass -- doesn't block boot or any core functionality. LPC formatter run across all 10260 files; reverted 2 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (clone/npc/tdh/idea.h, clone/obj/job/func.lpc) found via a same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 191 formatter-touched files; also directly diff-reviewed all 3 map.lpc ASCII-art zone-map files present (d/lanzhou, d/shaolin x2) -- all clean, cosmetic reformatting only. Post-formatter re-verified clean boot and registration.
